title: 连接 Sif MCP
description: 填写您的 Sif MCP 密钥（Secret Key）以连接 Sif 亚马逊运营分析服务。密钥仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录，不会上传云端。
description_en: Enter your Sif MCP Secret Key to connect Sif's Amazon Seller Analytics Service. The key is stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only and is never uploaded to the cloud.
docLabel: 如何获取 Sif MCP 密钥？
docLabel_en: How to get a Sif MCP Secret Key?

fields.label: Sif MCP 密钥
fields.placeholder: sifmcp 开头的完整密钥（在 sif.com → MCP 控制台 → 密钥管理获取）
fields.placeholder_en: Full key starting with 'sifmcp' (get it at sif.com → MCP Console → Secret Keys)
fields.description: 先在 https://www.sif.com/mcp 开通 MCP 服务，再到「密钥管理」页复制完整密钥（sifmcp 开头）。
fields.description_en: Subscribe at https://www.sif.com/mcp first, then copy the full key from the 'Secret Keys' page (starts with 'sifmcp').
